cds.text: Explore how language differs at home and school depending on relationships
Understand how language, facial expressions and gestures are used to ask, inform, offer, exclaim, request and command
Investigate how interpersonal language choices vary with context and the roles people take on
Explore different ways of using language to express preferences, likes and dislikes
Explore language used to give reasons for likes, dislikes and preferences
Explore language for appreciating texts and giving reasons for preferences
Interact in informal and structured situations by listening while others speak and using voice features, including volume
Use interaction skills: turn-taking, clear speech, active listening, responding to others, and contributing ideas and questions
Use interaction skills to engage with topics, receive and give instructions, extend ideas, and express and respond to opinions
Create and deliver short spoken texts to report ideas and events to peers, using appropriate volume
Create and deliver short oral or multimodal presentations with an opening, middle and concluding statement, using topic vocabulary, gesture, volume and pace
Create, rehearse and deliver short presentations for familiar audiences, using purpose-appropriate structure, topic vocabulary, and varied tone, volume and pace
